svg.text: Five cuts of the 001 ether climbing into the same trap
Last 1,500 ticks before entry into t001. Column 1 is at the bottom. Light: agrees with the trap’s 21-tick pattern. Dark: differs. Grey: columns 39 to 47, which have no pattern.
cut of 144 columns, class (0, 0): entered at tick 30,968
cut of 33 columns, class (1, 0): entered at tick 21,317
cut of 66 columns, class (0, 0): entered at tick 3,037
cut of 120 columns, class (1, 0): entered at tick 5,123
cut of 231 columns, class (0, 0): entered at tick 12,808
